title: Data Smells in Public Datasets
reasoning: The paper substantively deals with ethical issues in AI by identifying and cataloguing 'data smells'. One of the core smells discussed, 'Presence of sensitive features' (misc-sensitive), directly addresses how features like race and sex in datasets can lead to biased, unfair, and ethically problematic machine learning models, particularly in high-stakes domains like criminal justice. This analysis of ethically relevant data properties is a key part of the paper's contribution, not a peripheral discussion.
